issue_context.title: GeoJSON: Error doing job: Future exception was never retrieved
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I use a GeoJSON WebService which returns the following GeoJSON:
```json
{
    "type": "Feature",
    "geometry": {
        "type": "Point",
        "coordinates": [
            -98.25064432985364,
            50.85808415699699
        ]
    },
    "properties": {
        "timestamp": 1646225736,
        "refresh": 5,
        "alias": "My Point"
    }
}
```

When I want to use this GeoJSON in Home Assistant I get the following error in my logs:
```
Logger: homeassistant
Source: components/geo_json_events/geo_location.py:95
First occurred: 11:02:41 AM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 11:02:41 AM

Error doing job: Future exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson/base.py", line 40, in __getattr__
    return self[name]
KeyError: 'features'

During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/lib/python3.9/concurrent/futures/thread.py", line 52, in run
    result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/geo_json_events/geo_location.py", line 68, in start_feed_manager
    feed.startup()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/geo_json_events/geo_location.py", line 95, in startup
    self._feed_manager.update()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson_client/feed_manager.py", line 69, in update
    status, feed_entries = self._feed.update()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson_client/__init__.py", line 80, in update
    return self._update_internal(lambda entries: self._filter_entries(entries))
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson_client/__init__.py", line 61, in _update_internal
    for feature in data.features:
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson/base.py", line 42, in __getattr__
    raise AttributeError(name)
AttributeError: features
```

I'm guessing the integration is looking for an `Features` element in the JSON, however a `Feature` element is given in the JSON.

I have validated the JSON in [GeoJSONLint](https://geojsonlint.com/) and it seems to be a valid GeoJSON.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.2.9

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

GeoJSON

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/geo_json_events/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
geo_location:
  - platform: geo_json_events
    url: https://somedomain/file.json
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Source: components/geo_json_events/geo_location.py:95
First occurred: 11:02:41 AM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 11:02:41 AM

Error doing job: Future exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson/base.py", line 40, in __getattr__
    return self[name]
KeyError: 'features'

During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/lib/python3.9/concurrent/futures/thread.py", line 52, in run
    result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/geo_json_events/geo_location.py", line 68, in start_feed_manager
    feed.startup()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/geo_json_events/geo_location.py", line 95, in startup
    self._feed_manager.update()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson_client/feed_manager.py", line 69, in update
    status, feed_entries = self._feed.update()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson_client/__init__.py", line 80, in update
    return self._update_internal(lambda entries: self._filter_entries(entries))
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson_client/__init__.py", line 61, in _update_internal
    for feature in data.features:
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/geojson/base.py", line 42, in __getattr__
    raise AttributeError(name)
AttributeError: features
```


### Additional information

comments:
Hey there @exxamalte, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`geo_json_events`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L359) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Could you please provide the whole JSON response? Is there just an opening bracket `{` missing, or is there more missing at the beginning?

This integration currently only supports GeoJSON feeds that contain a feature collection, not single geometries. I guess the reason for this design decision was that in practice I had never found any examples that provided other than feature collections. If you could let me know where you are retrieving this GeoJSON from and provide a few examples, I could look into supporting that feed, too.
@exxamalte yes, there was just a missing { due to a formatting error in my message. So it's a very little GeoJSON message with just one point

review_comments:
A future improvement would be to use our coordinator update helper instead.

https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/integration_fetching_data#coordinated-single-api-poll-for-data-for-all-entities
Yes, agree. I wanted to keep this PR light-weight and migrate to the coordinator later.
